lessons.title: Setting Up Your Company

steps.title: Enter the company name
steps.instruction: Type Greenline Studio into the Company name field.

feedback.correct: Great. QuickBooks now knows which company file you are setting up.
feedback.incorrect: Enter Greenline Studio in the Company name field.

steps.title: Choose the industry
steps.instruction: Open the Industry dropdown and choose Professional services.

feedback.correct: Industry selected. QuickBooks uses this to suggest accounts and reports.
feedback.incorrect: Choose Professional services from the Industry dropdown.

steps.title: Save the setup
steps.instruction: Click Save to finish the simulated company setup.

quiz.question: Why does QuickBooks ask for an industry during setup?
options: To suggest useful accounts and reports
quiz.correctAnswer: To suggest useful accounts and reports
quiz.explanation: Industry details help QuickBooks tailor the chart of accounts and setup recommendations.

lessons.completionMessage: You set up the core company profile for a QuickBooks Online file.

lessons.title: Dashboard Navigation

steps.title: Review sales activity
steps.instruction: Click the Sales card to review customer activity.

feedback.incorrect: Look for the Sales card in the dashboard content area.

steps.title: Check banking
steps.instruction: Click the Banking card to see bank feed status.

feedback.incorrect: Select the Banking card near the cash-flow summary.

steps.title: Open settings
steps.instruction: Click the settings gear in the top bar.

feedback.correct: The settings area is where company preferences live.
feedback.incorrect: Click the gear icon on the top right.

quiz.question: Where do you usually find company preferences in QuickBooks Online?
quiz.explanation: The gear icon opens settings and company preference tools.

lessons.completionMessage: You toured the key dashboard areas used in everyday QuickBooks work.

lessons.title: Chart of Accounts Overview

steps.title: Open the chart
steps.instruction: Click the Chart of accounts row in the Accounting center.

feedback.correct: The chart lists the accounts used to classify activity.
feedback.incorrect: Click the row labeled Chart of accounts.

steps.title: Start a new account
steps.instruction: Click New to begin adding an account.

feedback.correct: A new account drawer is ready.
feedback.incorrect: Click the green New button above the account list.

steps.title: Choose account type
steps.instruction: Set the account type to Income.

feedback.correct: Income accounts track money earned from customers.
feedback.incorrect: Choose Income from the Account type menu.

quiz.question: What is the chart of accounts used for?
quiz.explanation: Every transaction posts to one or more accounts so reports can summarize financial activity.

lessons.completionMessage: You reviewed the role of accounts and added the first pieces of an account setup.
